title: Gobble Gobble Wobble 🦃 Thanksgiving Dance Song for Kids | Freeze Dance Brain Break | Tiny Turn Up
description:
Gobble gobble WOBBLE! 🦃 A Thanksgiving dance-along and freeze dance for kids ages 3–7. Flap, strut, wobble and FREEZE with Jojo, Kiki and Waddles the duck!

Perfect for classroom brain breaks, preschool and kindergarten movement time, PE warm-ups and Thanksgiving parties at home.

New Tiny Turn Up dance songs every week!
#thanksgivingsongsforkids #kidsdance #brainbreak
thumbnail_prompt: Jojo and Kiki mid-dance wearing paper turkey-feather headbands, flapping arms like turkeys, wide happy open mouths; Waddles wobbling beside them in a tiny pilgrim hat; autumn playground court with orange leaves flying. Right third: bold chunky text 'GOBBLE WOBBLE!' in yellow with thick black outline, and small text 'TINY TURN UP' with a gold crown above it. Extreme fun energy.
